values.name: Summary
values.description: Returns a high-level operational status suitable for quickly determining overall view health.

values.name: Detailed
values.description: Returns a comprehensive operational status, including detailed information about individual checks, dependencies, and any issues impacting view operability.

OperationalStatusStates.description: The overall operational status states for a sovereign view.

values.name: Healthy
values.description: The sovereign view is healthy and fully operational.

values.name: Unhealthy

values.name: Unknown
values.description: The operational status of the sovereign view could not be determined.

PolicyComplianceState.description: Supported compliance states for the policy initiatives.

values.name: Compliant
values.description: The resource is compliant with respect to the given policy.

values.name: NonCompliant
values.description: The resource is not compliant with respect to the given policy.

values.name: Conflict
values.description: The resource is in a conflict with respect to the given policy.

values.name: NotApplicable
values.description: The resource is in a state that is not applicable to the given policy.

values.name: NotEvaluated
values.description: The resource has not been evaluated for compliance with respect to the given policy.

values.name: Others
values.description: The resource is in a compliance state other than Compliant, NonCompliant, Conflict, NotApplicable, or NotEvaluated.

values.name: Generating
values.description: The compliance report is being generated for the first time.

values.name: NoDataYet
values.description: No compliance data is available yet.

values.name: UpToDate
values.description: The compliance report is up to date.

values.name: Retrying
values.description: The compliance report generation is being retried.

values.name: Refreshing

values.name: Stale
values.description: The compliance report is stale and pending refresh.

values.name: Blocked
values.description: The compliance report generation is blocked.
